about: Release ship list (DEP-08, decision 0064): tools/rel_build.py zips the paths of 'git ls-tree' at the ref that match an include pattern and no exclude pattern. A shipped path that matches a cache_deny pattern, or that safe_path refuses (a dotfile such as app/.npmrc, the dev-only npm config), refuses the build, so such a path is excluded here. '*' stays inside one path segment, '**' spans segments.
name: AshLight
